s: Ezeh debarim qeruyim hepseq basseuda, ubo t' seipim: haya okel becheder zeh venatal hammaakal beyado vehalak lecheder acher leekol — tzarik lachazor ulebarek, shekkevan sheamad vehalak lemaqom acher — amidato zo hi gemar akilato, vezo akila acheret hi, uteuna beraka battechilla ap al pi shello hissiach dato benetayim. Vaapillu chozer limqomo leekol — tzarik lachazor ulebarek, shekkevan sheshshinna meqomo benetayim hipsiq akilato. Abal becheder echad mizzavit lezavit eno niqra shinnuy maqom, apillu hu teraqlin gadol. Veim mittechilla keshebberak becheder zeh haya bedato leshannot meqomo mecheder lecheder beemtza akilato, apillu okel bacheder hashsheni maakal acher shebbirkato kebirkat harishon — en tzarik lachazor ulebarek. Vehu sheyyihyu shene hachadarim bebayit echad, abal mibbayit lebayit o apillu mibbayit lechatzer — en dato moelet kelum, apillu notel hammaakal beyado kesheholek vechozer veokelo belo hessach haddaat benetayim. Umikkol maqom, im bammaqom sheokel yakol lirot et meqomo harishon sheakal sham, apillu derek challon, vaapillu miqtzat meqomo — en tzarik lachazor ulebarek apillu mibbayit lechatzer, vaapillu lo haya ken bedato keshebberak, vaapillu al maakal acher shebbirkato kebirkat harishon, im haya bedato leekol keshebberak, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman r"v:

Vekol zeh beyachid, o bibne chabura veaqeru kullam mimmaqom lemaqom, abal im hinnichu miqtzatam bimqomam, apillu echad mehem, vehashshear haleku kullam, apillu lebayit acher, apillu eno samuk lebayit zeh, keshehem chozerim en tzerikim lebarek al mah sheyyoklu kan keillu lo aqeru mimmeqomam kelal benetayim, kevan shehinnichu miqtzat chabrehem nishara qebiutam kan veen zo aqira. Abal im rotzim leekol bammaqom shehaleku — tzerikim lebarek, veen moil mah shehinnichu miqtzat chabrehem becheder zeh lemah sheyyoklu becheder acher:

Vekol zeh bidbarim sheen teunim beraka leacharehem bimqomam, kegon kol okel umashqeh shebbirkatam haacharona hi "bore nepashot rabbot", sheen tzarik lebarek beraka acharona bimqom akila o shetiyya, ella rashshay laamod mimmeqomo qodem sheyyebarek velelek lemaqom acher lebarek sham, lepikak, amidato mimmeqomo lelek — zehu gemar seudato, ukeshechozer veokel o shoteh bemaqom acher o leachar shechozer limqomo — seuda acheret hi, uteuna beraka shenit ap al pi shello berak adayin beraka acharona al seuda harishona. Abal debarim hatteunim beraka leacharehem bimqomam, kegon pat, o apillu maaseh qedera mechameshet hamminim, o apillu perot miz' hamminim veyayin, shebbirkatan haacharona hoil vehi meen g' berakot shel birkat hammazon — hi chashuba lehatzrik ulebarek bimqom akila o shetiyya kemo birkat hammazon, lepikak, keshehu omed mimmeqomo lelek lemaqom acher — en amidato gemar seudato, shehare tzarik hu lachazor limqomo lebarek beraka haacharona, laken keshechozer veokel veshoteh apillu bemaqom acher, al daat seudato harishona hu okel mishshum lesayyem seudato, veen tzarik lomar keshechozer limqomo, veen tzarik lebarek battechilla apillu lo hinniach miqtzat chaberim. Vehu sheakal kebar kazzayit, abal pachot mikkazzayit dinam kidbarim sheen teunim beraka leacharehem bimqomam. Veyesh omerim shemmin dagan lebad taun beraka leacharayv bimqomo, mippene chashibuto shenniqra mazon. Veyesh omerim pat bilbad. Ulekattechilla yachamir bekol shibat hamminim lebarek bimqomo, veken bediabad im shinna meqomo — en tzarik lachazor ulebarek, shessepeq berakot lehaqel:

Vaapillu halak betok hasseuda lebayit acher, veokel veshoteh sham debarim sheenam tepelim lasseuda leinyan beraka rishona, vehutzrak lebarek alehem babbayit harishon, kemo yayin uperot, kevan shehem tepelim leinyan beraka acharona veniptarim bebirkat hammazon — al daat seudato harishona hu okel veshoteh, veen tzarik lebarek alehem sham apillu lo akal sham pat, vaapillu lo haya bedato keshebberak "hammotzi" leshannot meqomo beemtza seudato. Veim okel sham pat — mebarek birkat hammazon bammaqom sheggomer akilat happat, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qp"d. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla asur laaqor kelal mimmeqomo ad sheyyebarek birkat hammazon techilla im lo haya ken bedato keshebberak "hammotzi", shekkol dabar hattaun beraka leacharayv bimqomo mippene chashibuto — taun lebarek acharayv qodem sheyyaaqor mimmeqomo (shekkemo shemmoelet chashibuto shello lebarek bemaqom acher — kak moelet chashibuto lebarek qodem sheyyaaqor lemaqom acher, veap sheyyokal gam bammaqom hashsheni vibarek sham, mah moil zeh laakila harishona shehayeta teuna beraka bimqomah lekattechilla qodem sheyyaaqor mishsham mishshum chashibut. Ella sheim kebar aqar — en tzarik lachazor ulebarek, shebbazeh lo yetaqqen mah sheivvet baaqirato, ella mishshum shetztzarik lebarek bimqom akila — okel hu meat bammaqom hashsheni umebarek. Abal lekattechilla lo yaaqor belo beraka, vaapillu im hinniach miqtzat chaberim sheen zo aqira im haya atid lachazor alehem, mikkol maqom, kesheholek ligmor seudato bebayit acher — hare hu oqer mechaburato. Abal im holek al daat lachazor limqomo ligmor seudato — en zo aqira bidbarim hatteunim beraka leacharehem bimqomam, apillu lo hinniach miqtzat chaberim. Umikkol maqom, tzarik sheyyelek al daat leekol sham, kemo sheyyitbaer. Vaapillu holek shello al daat lachazor) im mittechilla keshebberak "hammotzi" haya bedato ligmor bebayit acher — muttar, shehare mittechilla lo qaba bemaqom zeh kol seudato, ukemo shennohagim holeke derakim sheokelim derek hillukam veyoshebim umebarekim bimqom siyyum akilatam, mippene shellekak nitkavvenu mittechilla shello liqboa maqom laakilatam bammaqom shebbereku "hammotzi" vehitchilu sham leekol:

Vekol zeh kesheholek lebayit acher leekol sham, abal im eno holek leekol sham, ap al pi shehaya bedato mittechilla lelek sham — asur lo laaqor mimmeqomo ad sheyyebarek birkat hammazon, vaapillu hinniach miqtzat chaberim, gezera shemma yishkach millachazor limqomo lebarek, mah sheen ken kesheholek leekol sham, shemmebarek bammaqom sheggomer seudato im shokeach lachazor limqomo, veen lachosh ella laaqira mimmeqom akila belo beraka im en dato lachazor limqomo ulebarek velo haya dato al zeh mittechilla:

Vekol zeh kesheholek lidbar hareshut, o apillu lidbar mitzva sheenah oberet, abal letzorek mitzva oberet, kegon liqrat chatan o liqrat kalla, o lebet hakkeneset lehitpallel im hatztzibbur — muttar lelek ulebarek birkat hammazon kesheyyachazor, vaapillu lo hinniach miqtzat chaberim, sheen lehaniach mitzva oberet mishshum chashash shemma yishkach. Vaapillu laaqor bisudato mibbayit lebayit ulebarek birkat hammazon babbayit haacharon velo haya dato al zeh mittechilla — muttar letzorek mitzva oberet, kegon lebarek sham bezimmun, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ta"t. Veap al pi shellaaqor qodem birkat hammazon shello al daat lachazor limqomo ulebarek, en haissur mishshum chashash shemma yishkach, ella issur gamur hu middibre soperim, veen oberin apillu al issur qal shel dibrehem mishshum mitzva oberet, mikkol maqom, kevan sheddato leekol bebayit acher ulebarek sham eno issur barur, sheyyesh lomar sheen zo aqira, shehare keshechozer veokel bebayit sheni en tzarik lebarek battechilla, mippene sheal daat seudato harishona hu okel lesayyem seudato vehakkol lisuda achat hi nechshebet, kemo shennitbaer. Ella lepi sheyyesh choleqin al zeh, kemo sheyyitbaer, uledibrehem haissur barur, vegam lepi sebara harishona yesh lomar sheap shehakkol seuda achat hi mikkol maqom bishne meqomot hi, vekol mah sheakal bemaqom zeh tzarik lebarek acharayv miyyad lekattechilla qodem sheyyaaqor lemaqom acher — lepikak en lehaqel apillu letzorek mitzva oberet im lo haya dato al zeh mittechilla:

Im amad vehalak lidbar hareshut apillu shaha sham harbeh, kol shello shaha kede sheyyitakkel hammazon shebbemeayv — en tzarik lachazor ulebarek "hammotzi" keshechozer leekol bimqomo o bemaqom acher im lo hissiach dato benetayim. Abal im hissiach dato milleekol od, kevan sheyyesh kan hessach haddaat veshinnuy maqom — tzarik lachazor ulebarek "hammotzi", mittaam sheyyitbaer besiman qa"t. Vegam tzarik lachazor velittol yadayv apillu lo shaha kelal, shekkevan shehissiach dato min haakila, min hassetam lo nizhar bishmirat yadayv vehissiach dato mehen. Vaapillu lo hissiach dato milleekol, im hiplig harbeh bidbarim — tzarik lachazor velittol yadayv, ap al pi sheen tzarik lebarek "hammotzi", mippene shemmin hassetam hissiach dato mishshemiratan, kemo shennitbaer besiman qs"d. Veyesh mi sheomer, shehu haddin im amad lehitpallel beemtza seudato tzarik lachazor velittol yadayv achar hattepilla keshechozer lisuddato, mishshum chashash hessach haddaat bishat hattepilla, ella im ken shamar yadayv (kemo shebbelel pesach, ap al pi shennatal yadayv betibbul rishon — chozer venotel lasseuda mishshum chashash hessach haddaat bishat amirat hahaggada, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ta"h). Ulepi mah shennitbaer besiman tz"b shehaiqqar kehaomerim shehessach haddaat posel bitpilla kemo baakila — en tzarik lachazor velittol yadayv achar hattepilla, shehare mishshum tepilla atzmah eno massiach dato, mah sheen ken baamirat hahaggada belel pesach sheen hessach haddaat posel bah — chosheshim shemma hissiach dato. Abal birkat "hammotzi" en tzarik lebarek ledibre hakkol, apillu halak lebet hakkeneset lehitpallel veshaha sham harbeh kol shello hissiach dato milleekol od, veen hattepilla chashuba hepseq basseuda apillu haya mukrach lehapsiq ulehitpallel, mippene sheen shehut od bayyom lehitpallel achar kak. Veap al pi shebbishat hattepilla i epshar lo leekol meuma — enah chashuba hepseq mishshum zeh. Veeno domeh lebirkat hammazon shechashuba hepseq mishshum zeh lehatzrik beraka al kos birkat hammazon, hoil ubishat birkat hammazon i epshar lishtot, lepi shebbirkat hammazon hu silluq vehessach haddaat al mah sheakal veshata, mah sheen ken tepilla, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qa"t:

Veyesh omerim, sheddebarim hatteunim beraka leacharehem bimqomam dinam kidbarim sheen teunim beraka leacharehem bimqomam leinyan shinnuy maqom bediabad, shetztzarik lachazor ulebarek, ella im ken hinniach miqtzat chaberim. Abal lekattechilla asur laaqor mimmeqomo belo beraka acharona (vaapillu letzorek mitzva oberet) bidbarim hatteunim beraka leacharehem bimqomam, ella im ken hinniach miqtzat chaberim vedato lachazor limqomo, sheaz en zo aqira. Vaapillu bediabad shello hinniach miqtzat chaberim veaqar mimmeqomo vechazar — tzarik lebarek beraka acharona techilla veachar kak beraka rishona al mah sheyyokal achar kak, shekkevan sheshshinna meqomo — hare pasaq seudato, vezo seuda acheret hi, vetzarik lebarek techilla al seuda harishona veachar kak yatchil seuda hashsheniyya. Vehamminhag bimdinot ellu kassebara harishona, lehaqel bedibre soperim. Veap lassebara haacharona — en shinnuy maqom chashub hepseq basseuda im chozer limqomo ella kesheshshaha chutz limqomo, kegon shehalak ledabber im chabero vehiplig bidbarim, o shehalak lebet hakkeneset lehitpallel, o shehalak leezeh eseq veshaha bo. Abal im lo shaha, apillu asa ezeh dabar middibre hareshut bederek aray, kegon shehutzrak linqabayv veniknas lebet hakkisse vekayyotze bazeh (eno chashub hepseq basseuda. Veen tzarik lomar im dibber im chabero velo hiplig, vaapillu hu debar hareshut). (Veen tzarik lomar im yatza lehabi dabar mitztzorke hasseuda) (velaken hashshammash hamshammesh basseuda, ap al pi sheholek uba tamid mimmaqom lemaqom — eno nechshab shinnuy maqom lo lachazor ulebarek bekol paam shebba, ap lepi sebara zo). (Vehu haddin lassebara harishona — en shinnuy maqom chashub hepseq bekol zeh basseuda ap im adayin lo akal kazzayit sheen tzarik lebarek kelal beraka acharona. Vehu haddin bidbarim sheenam teunim beraka leacharehem bimqomam im qaba alehem vehem debarim sheqqebiutam qebiut, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ry"g, mippene sheen hepseq aray chashub lehapsiq seudat qeba). Veen tzarik lomar mi sheyyashan shenat aray bimqom seudato, sheen chashub hepseq basseuda, vechozer veokel belo beraka ledibre hakkol. Abal shenat qeba hu silluq vehessach haddaat yoter midday, vachashuba hepseq ledibre hakkol ap al pi sheyyashan bimqom seudato. Abal kol shenneor, ap al pi shehiplig harbeh bidbarim acherim bimqom seudato, kol shello hissiach dato milleekol — chozer veokel belo beraka ledibre hakkol. Veyesh omerim sheapillu hissiach dato, kemo shennitbaer besiman qa"t:

Haokel besadeh sheenah muqqepet mechitztzot, kevan shennitracheq ad shello yukal lirot meqomo harishon — niqra shinnuy (kemo mecheder lecheder shebbeheqqep mechitztzot). Vaapillu okel perot hailan bemizracho vechozer veokel bemaarabo, kevan sheeno roeh meqomo mippene hailan shemmapsiq — niqra shinnuy maqom, vetzarik lachazor ulebarek im lo haya bedato leekol bemaarabo keshebberak bemizracho. Abal im okel becheder echad, ap al pi sheyyesh maqom gaboah beemtza uba leekol acharayv, kegon achore hattannur sheeno yakol lirot mishsham meqomo harishon — en zeh shinnuy maqom, shekkevan shemmuqqap mechitztzot hare hakkol echad. Veken im haya baggan verotzeh leekol mipperot kol ilan veilan, kevan shebberak al echad — en tzarik lachazor ulebarek al haacherim im haya bedato ken keshebberak, sheim lo ken nimlak hu, vetzarik lachazor ulebarek. Veap al pi shehaya bedato ken, im en haggan muqqap mechitztzot — en dato moelet kelum lekol hailanot sheeno roeh meqomo harishon, shezzehu shinnuy maqom shetztzarik lachazor ulebarek, veeno domeh kelal leilan echad mimmizracho lemaarabo, shehu kemo mecheder lecheder bebayit echad sheddato moelet, abal shinnuy maqom shemmeilan leilan domeh leshinnuy maqom shemmibbayit lebayit, kevan sheenan muqqapim mechitztzot. Abal kol sheroeh meqomo harishon — en kan shinnuy maqom kelal, apillu meilan leilan, kevan sheeno muqqap mechitztzot. Veyesh mi shemmachamir gam bazeh. Usepeq berakot lehaqel. Umiggan legan hammuqqapim mechitztzot kol echad bipne atzmo, apillu hen semukim zeh lazeh — tzarik lachazor ulebarek, apillu im keshebberak haya dato al hakkol, lepi shehem kemo mibbayit lebayit sheen dato moelet kelum:
